product.title: Paul Mitchell MITCH Steady Grip Styling Gel
product.body_html:
Get a steady grip on any style with this styling gel that helps hair look thicker while shaping and separating with medium hold and medium shine.
The alcohol-free formula helps prevent drying and flaking, leaving hair polished with a clean finish

Hair Type:

  • For all hair types. Ideal for fine and thinning hair, thick or coarse hair, and for defining curls on damp hair

Benefits:

  • Shapes and separates any style
  • Helps hair look and feel thicker
  • Provides medium hold with medium shine
  • Leaves a clean, flake-free finish
  • Non-drying formula
  • Color-safe
  • Vegan
  • Paraben-free
  • Made without gluten 

How to Use:

Apply a small amount to palms and distribute through damp hair for lighter hold or through dry hair for stronger hold. For thick or coarse hair, apply a small amount to damp or dry hair and add more if needed. For fine or thinning hair, apply a small amount to dry hair

Ingredients:

Long-lasting styling fixatives in Steady Grip Styling Gel help provide all-day hold, while shine enhancers leave hair looking polished and the alcohol-free formula helps prevent drying and flakes
